card.name: Small words in historical encyclopedia prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, of, les, des) and number pieces inside historical or biographical encyclopedia text about European or Near Eastern states, rulers and wars.

modes.label: Linking words in history
modes.description: Words like to, of, des, les after a noun or verb in narrative about empires, kings and religious conflict.
modes.example: the Assyrian Empire began to unravel due<< to>> a series of bitter civil wars.

modes.label: Digits in sums of money
modes.description: A digit partway through a number of livres in a historical anecdote.
modes.example: He received forthwith a pension of 200<<0>> livres.
